info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/vggt-1b
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/vggt-1b queue.

x-fal-metadata.about:
Reconstruct 3D scene geometry from images and/or a video with VGGT-1B.

A single feed-forward pass jointly estimates camera extrinsics and
intrinsics, per-frame depth and depth confidence for every input view.

enable_safety_checker.description: Enable safety checking of the input images and video.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

export_point_cloud.description: Return a GLB scene holding the fused coloured point cloud plus a cone mesh per estimated camera.
export_point_cloud.title: Export Point Cloud

confidence_percentile.description: Drop this percentage of the lowest-confidence points before building the point cloud. 0 keeps every point.
confidence_percentile.title: Confidence Percentile

exclude_keys.title: Exclude Keys
exclude_keys.description: Keys to omit from each prediction JSON file.

alpha_blend_onto.description: How to handle images with an alpha channel. 'white'/'black' composite onto that background, 'mean' composites onto the ImageNet mean RGB, and 'keep' discards alpha and keeps the original pixel values.
alpha_blend_onto.title: Alpha Blend Onto

video_url.title: Video Url
video_url.description: Optional input video. Frames are sampled every `frame_sampling_rate`-th frame (the first and last frames are always included) and appended after `image_urls`.

frame_sampling_rate.description: Sample every n-th frame of `video_url`. The first and last frames of the video are always included. Ignored when no video is given.
frame_sampling_rate.title: Frame Sampling Rate

export_prediction_data.description: Return one JSON file per frame with the raw model outputs (camera pose encoding, depth, depth confidence, mask).
export_prediction_data.title: Export Prediction Data

max_points.description: Upper bound on the number of points written to the GLB. Points above the default 250,000-point budget are evenly subsampled to limit GLB serialization and upload latency.
max_points.title: Max Points

image_urls.title: Image Urls
image_urls.description: Input images to reconstruct. Accepts JPEG, PNG, WEBP and the other formats Pillow decodes. Images are padded to a square and resized so the longest side is 518 pixels.

array_encoding.description: How arrays are encoded inside the prediction JSON files. 'base64' emits {data, shape, dtype} objects; 'list' emits nested JSON lists, which are far larger.
array_encoding.title: Array Encoding

export_depth_maps.description: Return one 16-bit grayscale PNG depth raster per frame. Pixel values map linearly from `depth_range` onto 0-65535.
export_depth_maps.title: Export Depth Maps

depth_maps.title: Depth Maps
depth_maps.description: One 16-bit grayscale PNG depth raster per frame, in frame order (when `export_depth_maps` is true).

intrinsics.title: Intrinsics
intrinsics.description: Per-frame 3x3 pinhole intrinsics, in pixels of the 518x518 model frame.

extrinsics.title: Extrinsics
extrinsics.description: Per-frame 3x4 camera-from-world extrinsics in OpenCV convention (x-right, y-down, z-forward).

prediction_data.title: Prediction Data
prediction_data.description: One JSON file of raw predictions per frame, in frame order (when `export_prediction_data` is true).

depth_range.title: Depth Range
depth_range.description: The [min, max] depth used to quantize `depth_maps`. depth = min + (pixel / 65535) * (max - min).

num_frames.title: Num Frames
num_frames.description: Number of frames reconstructed (images plus sampled video frames).

point_cloud.description: GLB scene with the fused point cloud and camera cones (when `export_point_cloud` is true).

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
